title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. When I am going out, I always making WUZU. One day I went out side with WUZU. When I returned, ASR Azan started, I thought I have WUZU pray salah then go to home. Now salah started and I was in the middle of the first saf(line). After one rakat is over, then I remember I had passed Urine at an office. That time I have completed salah because there was no way to go back from any side. after finishing salah I went home, changed my clothes made WUZU and repeated ASR salah. Is it OK? answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 38589 Country: Pakistan Title: When I do potty (pakhana) while doing some force to do it I see that some drops of semen comes out from my penis Question: When I do potty (pakhana) while doing some force to do it I see that some drops of semen comes out from my penis. Does this make me to do ghusl? Please answer. I have problem in offering prayer due to this problem. Answer ID: 38589 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 934/767/B=1433) The drop which is discharged while excreting stool does not make ghusl wajib. You should offer salah only by making wudhu. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
